name: com.netease.yunxin.nertc.ui.p2p.P2PCallActivity
description: When a user starts or answers a NetEase Yunxin CallKit one-to-one voice or video call, this Activity shows the call screen and its answer, reject, mute, camera, speaker, and hang-up controls.
disableEffect: One-to-one calls routed to this screen may not open, preventing users from placing or answering them.
